data.text:
On August 4th, 2021, 4 years ago to the day, I had a remote-viewing experience while putting my child to sleep that completely altered my understanding of reality and led to the complete unlocking of the mystery and the enigma that is the 589. My child has always been sensitive to my mental state, particularly when trying to fall asleep. Typically, I must place myself into a lowered state of neural oscillation to have any chance of success. In this case, to mimic sleep is to induce sleep. This night, my mind was racing, and all my efforts seemed in vain. I was highly focused on Japan, which was hosting the 2021 Olympics. I was fascinated by the global “virus” that preceded the event, initially postponing it, effectively mirroring events in the 1988 classic Japanese anime film Akira right down to the empty stadium and the cancelled countdown board. Even though I had considered myself awake for decades by this point, this unusual sense of reality and events of the world were making me question everything in ways I hadn’t even considered; fiction and reality were beginning to blur in ways I had completely overlooked before.

Moreover, my excitement was at an all-time high due to the announcement that Ripple had launched its first On-Demand Liquidity (ODL) service with Japan, on August 4, 2021, specifically for payments between the Philippines and Japan as a collaboration between Ripple and SBI Remit, one of Japan's largest money transfer companies -- If you were into XRP at the time, this was a big deal and the potential of the development seemed out of this world.

Struggling for over an hour with my child, I found myself in and out of multiple states of consciousness. Out-of-body experiences were nothing new to me, but never had I found myself in a state where I could say that I was remote viewing, or at least have supporting evidence to back up the experience I was witness to. At one point, I found myself deep underwater off the coast of Japan. What I witnessed there started it all, an event that forever ripped off the veil I didn’t even know existed—three (3) underwater explosions off the coast of Japan.

Frustrated, and my child still wide-eyed and nowhere near sleep, I left the room and asked my wife to take over. Thinking nothing of the last hour, the only thing I wanted was to decompress for the night. Reaching for my phone off the kitchen counter, the second I opened it, there were three notifications. Chills, unlike anything I had experienced, ran up and down my body -- Japan had just experienced and recorded three (3) separate underwater earthquakes that were felt in Tokyo and certainly brought fear to those who had gathered for the games. Keep in mind, Japan had just experienced the 9.1M earthquake on March 11th (311), 2021, that triggered the devastating Tsunami that may have reached heights of 133 feet, causing loss of life and billions of dollars in damages.

Stunned at what I had just read. My phone told me about three earthquakes, though only moments ago I had witnessed three underwater explosions in the exact location as the epicentre of the earthquakes. It later turned out that the earthquakes recorded were the 3rd, 6th, and 9th(369) most powerful earthquakes in the world that day. Truth resonates differently; this didn’t feel right. There was no doubt in my mind that this event was induced–on–demand. But why? – I needed to know.
Within hours, I had already received answers. What was revealed was nothing less than a revelation of the highest order. It was the ultimate truth -- it was the 589.

What subtly began to hit me was that, no more and no less than three (3) days earlier, I had reached out to the universe. This was not for myself, but for those that I loved. An email I had received from my mother, forwarded from a clairvoyant friend of hers, talked about a beautiful future, describing a new quantum financial system and a world without suffering. Though beautifully written and mostly echoing what I had already learned of the potential of XRP. It also reminded me of the chatter from the so-called Q movement that I had intentionally avoided for years until that point. Most of this I had already heard or knew about, but I honestly did not want my loved ones to be duped by rumours and internet fantasies. In a complete selfless act, I connected my mind and my heart, I asked for help. Knowing what I already know to be true, how can I prove her statement with the knowledge that I already have inside me? Unknowingly, I had unlocked the 5D.

Today is the 4th anniversary of the day I found the truth of 589. It is beautiful beyond belief. It is not only something that you behold, but also something to be understood and applied. It is no less than the simplified expression of the matrix of life. Without this lens, the world is full of chaos, pain and disorder; with it, the world has meaning, beauty, and reveals an ordered truth long hidden from our eyes. 
 
The power and the glory of the 589 cannot be understated.

Through the lens of the 589, I have found paradise for myself and the ones I love. From a distance, I have watched the world as an extra-environmentalist, as an outsider, and seemingly removed from the tragedy and destruction that is plaguing the world around us, at the same time bringing clarity and meaning to events that baffle the minds of those closest to my heart.

Ironically, despite this perspective and all my efforts to move and keep my family safe, the events of the world have caught up with us. At this very moment, we have been evacuated, we are without a home—the flames of destiny lap against the walls of my microcosm. Exactly 3 years, 11 months (311), 3 weeks, 4 days since the truth was revealed, an out-of-control forest fire burst into existence, ravaging a mountainside, displacing our entire village. 
 
Of course, this is no random accident. This fire was started 23 years, 9 months, 1 week, 1 day (911) ago with the intentional sinking of a solar boat off the coast of our beautiful island. Never in my wildest dreams would I have imagined that I would be caught up in the same ritual that took out most of the California Palisades. Nothing is without meaning in this world; one only needs the eyes, or at least the proper set of lenses, to reveal it. My only solace is knowing the root of this tragedy. I don’t care what is said to the contrary -- knowledge is bliss.
 
This post serves as a foundation, meant to be set in place. A guide marker, if you will, to the future. If you have not found it, I implore you to open your hearts and your minds to something that is within you all—the Spirit of Truth.
